lead.hed: Navy closes fiscal 2026 with 45,112 enlisted recruits, past its 45,000 goal
lead.insight: The Navy brought in at least 45,112 active-duty enlisted sailors in fiscal 2026, according to final numbers the service released Thursday, USNI News reported. The Navy said in July it had already reached its goal of 45,000, three months ahead of schedule. Every one of those enlistees starts at Recruit Training Command in Great Lakes, Ill., the Navy’s only boot camp, where training runs about nine weeks. The Navy has not yet published how the new fiscal year’s goal compares.
lead.image_credit: MC1 John Suits, U.S. Navy · DVIDS 9970231 · Public domain · Sailors stand in formation outside Midway Ceremonial Drill Hall during pass-in-review at Recruit Training Command, Great Lakes, Ill., Sept. 24, 2026.

political.hed: Pacific allies weigh U.S. signals after Trump’s talks with Xi
political.insight: Army leaders from 25 Indo-Pacific nations met in Auckland in late September to plan closer cooperation. In the same week, U.S. Ambassador David Perdue said President Trump had offered to sell weapons to China; Washington officials later said no such sale is planned. Larger arms packages for Taiwan remain on hold.

political.hed: Heritage warns a proposed $5,000-per-adult payment deepens the spending problem
political.insight: Heritage writes that President Trump has offered $5,000 to every American adult if Republicans win the midterms. The commentary argues both parties are now spending past what the Treasury can carry and asks whether federal spending can still be cut.

political.hed: Law & Liberty asks Washington for a real budget resolution as fiscal 2027 begins
political.insight: With the new fiscal year opening Oct. 1, Law & Liberty argues the country’s finances need more than promises and lays out what an honest budget commitment would require.

political.hed: Heritage pushes back on the shrinking-middle-class story
political.insight: Heritage argues that talk of a K-shaped economy leaves out the wealth effect: rising home and retirement values that many middle-class households also hold. The piece answers polls showing widespread economic pessimism.

tech.hed: Taiwan takes delivery of its first two new F-16V Block 70 fighters
tech.insight: The jets landed Friday at Chihhang Air Base in Taitung after flying via Hawaii and Guam, the first of 66 ordered in 2019 under an $8 billion sale. Software problems delayed delivery. The Block 70 carries newer radar, avionics and weapons; Defense Minister Wellington Koo said more would arrive soon but gave no dates.

culture.hed: Providence adds a pillar to the case that the War for Independence was a just war
culture.insight: Responding to J. Daryl Charles’ earlier Providence essay, the author agrees the American Revolution met the just war tradition’s moral and prudential tests and offers one more argument for that conclusion.

culture.hed: Public Discourse marks 75 years of “God and Man at Yale”
culture.insight: Looking back on William F. Buckley Jr.’s 1951 book, the essay asks whether a university, or a society with no shared moral reference points, can still defend the value of human life.
